annotations.title: File Extension and MIME Type Match

description: Check whether each file's extension agrees with the MIME (media) type sent with it, before a file is stored, shared or opened. Send up to 100 file names with their MIME types; get back per file: match, mismatch, obsolete or unregistered type (with the registered one to use), generic type, unknown extension or no extension, the types registered for the extension and the extensions for the type, and a warning for double extensions like report.pdf.exe. File names are not echoed, only extensions. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/file-extension-mime). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

file_name.description: The file name (a folder path is allowed; only the part after the last / or \ is read). Not echoed back.

mime_type.description: The MIME type sent with the file, such as application/pdf (parameters like '; charset=utf-8' are allowed and ignored).
